project_type: React 19 + TypeScript 5.9 + Vite 7 SPA for cat name tournament/voting
build_system: pnpm 10.27.0, Vite 7 with @tailwindcss/vite plugin, Biome for linting
test_framework: Vitest with jsdom environment, @testing-library/react, config at config/vitest.config.ts
verification_instructions: Run pnpm run build and confirm it succeeds. Run pnpm run test and confirm existing tests pass (1 pre-existing failure in sound.test.ts is acceptable).
environment_constraints: Node v20.19.6 at /opt/toolchains/.local/share/mise/installs/node/20.19.6/bin must be in PATH. No Docker daemon. 1 pre-existing test failure in sound.test.ts. Tailwind CSS 4 with @tailwindcss/vite plugin (no tailwind.config.js loaded - only @theme inline in tokens.css matters).
contribution_requirements: Use pnpm, commit with conventional commit format (feat:/fix:/chore:), run lint/build to verify.
key_patterns: Tailwind CSS 4 uses @theme inline in src/styles/tokens.css for utility class registration. Custom CSS in src/styles/ uses BEM for navbar, @utility for glass-surface. Components use cn() from shared/lib/utils (clsx + tailwind-merge). The config/tailwind.config.js is a DEAD FILE not loaded by TW4 since there is no @config directive in CSS.
directory_structure: src/styles/ - design system CSS (tokens, motion, navbar, etc.). src/shared/ - shared components and utilities. src/features/ - feature modules (tournament, dashboard). src/app/ - app shell, routes, providers. config/ - build configs (vite, vitest, biome, tailwind). The tailwind.config.js in config/ is NOT loaded by TW4.
